notes.title: Changelog Demo v.1.4 - THE NPC UPDATE
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES


Hi everyone! We have been made aware that our game's median play time is already very high (thank you guys!) and that it wouldn't be smart to add more content to the demo, so people will be more inclined to buy the full game at the release date. 



But whoopsie, all this content dropped from our hands and right into the new update! 
How clumsy we are!


So, we added more stuff to make the demo more similar to the vision of what will be the actual final game. This will be the last content update for the DEMO. 

There will be bug fixes, but content-wise, the demo will not receive additional content aside from bug fixing. So have fun!

MAJOR UPDATES:
Now NPCs must be found before they offer their services to the hero:


Added the Blacksmith to the demo's NPC roster
Go look for him! He might be important to your next run!

Find Eden!
Yes, now Eden, our dear relic seller in the tavern, must be found around the dungeon.


New Achievements
Who doesn't like new achievements?


MAJOR FIXES:
Fixed a bug that caused monster cards to be destroyed by monsters’ sacrifice skills and abilities (yes, we're looking at you, turtle).

Polished the game interface

Monster book looks improved.


MINOR FIXES
Changed some monsters' effects to make it more balanced.

Minor bug fixes all around the game



That's all for now! As always, thank you so much for your feedback and support.

<3



Love, Atomic Hamster.

notes.title: Changelog Demo v.1.1 – THE CURSOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Changelog Demo v.1.1 – THE CURSOR UPDATE

Hey everyone!

We’ve just pushed a small update full of bug fixes, polish, and quality-of-life improvements for The Good Overlord demo. 

Let’s go over it:

MAJOR FIXES
Fixes & Tweaks:
- We rotated the cursor, now it points like a normal pointer would. 
We heard you. 
It happened. 
It was painful.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/65d261fb57df083c671a733c10aa375426379a9f.gif"]

- Lava tiles now react more clearly when the hero steps on them.

- Crossbows trajectory now don't make the game lag

- Hero pathfinding has been improved to prevent him from getting stuck.

- Several monster ability descriptions have been clarified.

Boss Fight:
- Carmelo – Turns out the hero was very committed to grabbing coins, even mid-boss phasing. We fixed that.

- MKUltra – Healing turrets no longer spawn on top of each other.

MINOR FIXES & POLISH
- More sound effects have been added across the board.

- Eden’s relic selection now gives clearer feedback when you select your relic.

- Shadow fixes on Eden's shop, now it doesn't cover the bottom UI.

- Keywords now appear even inside the bag when checking a monster data card

- Some balance tweaks here and there.

- New interactables have been added to the Overlord's office. Go poke around.

- All UI buttons now jiggle while they're hovered over. Yes, it was important.

notes.title: VERSION 1.0 OF THE DEMO IS NOW LIVE ON STEAM!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/ee83907e33c290a6d449736b099fb62157bfb51a.gif

Long time no see!
And that’s why it's time for a, drumroll, devlog!
First of all, version 1.0 of the demo will come out publicly (and hopefully without crucial bugs) on the 2nd of July during the #turnbasedthursday festival on Steam.
In this article, we will talk about all the new cool features, what is coming, and what we're working to fix!

Let’s start with the juice:

1) NEW FEATURES
THE SACRIFICE ROOM
The new addition to the game! Each monster (yes, all 300+ of them) has a special ability that will activate itself automatically during fights.
You should really play the demo and check out ALL of them. Some of them will give you cool accessories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/78a23f33cb26da8d3ca3b90ada8b87f77603afb2.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/301c859e3382cffed18e7edf6387ef2965ac795b.gif

JESTER WHEEL
Tired of not having enough RNG? No? Well, we were! So we added a room where you play the jester's game of "who will die next." Spin the wheel if you're brave enough, and maybe, just maybe, you'll get a cool bonus. Or you might sign up for your hero's death.
It is what it is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/20aaee825974f8684efa101e23a22232871a470b.gif

NEW HUD!
The HUD is constantly improving. We kept the same one for a long time due to lack of production time, but now, after hearing your feedback, we hope it'll be a bit more understandable.
The HP bar has a signal to show where the 50% mark is, so it's easier to understand when EMERGENCY abilities will pop up. There’s also a clearer way to check on XP and stats like DMG and COINS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/878584c822ccab561d8d849b1b77767e5b9be840.gif

ILLUMINATION
So, we haven't yet touched a lot of the illumination in the game. That's because we're giving priority to feedback and the mechanics themselves before really polishing everything up, but it'd be a shame not to show off our lighting system to y'all—so slowly but surely, we're adding lights everywhere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/7f5b8d3fbbad08c74996b6f8d5a567bb2572f51d.gif

2) WHAT’S TO COME
BLACKSMITH LIAR
We can't really say much about this one, but it would be a shame if the hero only wielded the same sword for the whole game, right? So, at the start of the run, if you find the right guy in the dungeon, he’ll... gift you the right sword to wield for the run.
Each sword has its own perks and abilities!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/60359b66d5cfd7ade1c644c4dd5aff9b23fd3125.gif

NEW EDEN UI
Our dear Eden's shop right now is just hidden beneath his coat. Yes, exactly like the dude who tries to sell sundials to another guy in a specific movie. Can’t really remember who the guy is though, huh.
But he's working on making the tavern a little bit more like his home. He's not there yet, but he's trying very hard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706493/110312649d12ccf5369f5b4d8c5c73ddede9ba7c.png


LISANDRA SHOP
So, it would be kind of weird if a bartender only sold you ONE specific drink, so we decided that you can pick between 3+ more drinks with different effects.
Yeah, tons of choices.

We know.

3) BUG FIX

We know there still might be some minor fixes and issues, and we always appreciate you giving us feedback!
We did work on most of the more annoying bugs, but as you all know, they are sneaky and hard to find. So If you guys find something, please do contact us through the button "Report a Bug" in the OPTIONS MENU!

That’s all for now.
We’re incredibly excited for you to dive into the updated demo during the #TurnBasedThursday event starting TODAY!

Until then, stay lucky, and have a good run in the dungeon!
